pages.title: Spirit Leaves
pages.text: Trees of the Night Forest bear a special kind of leaves. They can be broken even with a bare hand, and a $(item)Spirit Apple$() drops.

pages.title: Spirit Apple
pages.text: The effect depends on the form you are in when you finish eating.$(br2)$(#A33B3B)Human:$() Wither and Hunger for 5 min, Nausea for 10 s.$(br)$(#2E7D4F)Spirit:$() Absorption and Strength for 3 min.

pages.title: Advice
pages.text: $(#7952A6)Eat in Spirit Form.$() If you start in one form and finish in another, the effects of the form you end in apply.$(br2)Absorption and Strength make good preparation for a fight with a $(l:heralds/heralds)Herald$(/l).
